fullDescription: An editorial-grade minimalist design system featuring a premium palette of charcoal, navy, and gold. Characterized by high-contrast typography using the 'Outfit' and 'Inter' font families, the layout employs an asymmetric bento-grid and a vertical grid-line aesthetic. It is ideal for strategic consulting, fintech, high-end digital agencies, and professional services requiring a balance of authority and modern clarity. The design relies on 'rounded-none' geometry, heavy letter-spacing for uppercase elements, and scroll-triggered fade-in-up animations to create a sophisticated, trust-building user experience.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sophisticated, high-end business growth design system utilizing an editorial layout, sharp geometric shapes (no rounded corners), and a luxury color palette of Charcoal (#2C2C2C), Gold (#D4AF37), and Navy (#1F3A5F).

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual style based on high-end editorial magazines. Background: #F9F8F6. Primary Text: #2C2C2C. Primary Heading Font: 'Outfit', sans-serif, weights 400, 700. Secondary Body Font: 'Inter', sans-serif, weights 300, 400, 500, 600. Headings: large, tight tracking (-0.02em), leading 1.1. Accents: #D4AF37 (Gold) and #1F3A5F (Navy). Components: No border-radii (rounded-none). Borders: 1px solid #2C2C2C with 5-10% opacity for sections. Decorative elements: Vertical 1px lines at 10%, 33%, 66%, and 90% width of the container. Animation: Scroll-triggered fade-in-up with 1.2s duration and cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94). Buttons: Solid background #D4AF37 or #2C2C2C, uppercase text, tracking 0.3em, no rounding.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed top bar, height 80px (h-20), background #F9F8F6, border-bottom 1px solid #2C2C2C (10% opacity). Container max-width 1440px. Logo: 'Outfit', 24px, weight 700, tracking-tighter. Links: Uppercase, tracking 0.2em, font-size 14px, font-medium, hover color #D4AF37. Call-to-action button: background #2C2C2C, white text, no rounding.

### Hero Section
Full width with 1440px max-width container. Padding: 160px top, 96px bottom (pt-40 pb-24). 12-column grid. Heading (col-span-8): Text size 72px-128px (text-5xl to text-8xl), leading 1.1. Subtext (col-span-8): Text size 24px, font-light, color #2C2C2C at 70% opacity. Buttons: Two-button group, one solid #D4AF37, one 1px border #2C2C2C, both uppercase 14px, tracking 0.3em.

### Problem Statement Section
Background #FFFFFF, padding 96px vertical. 12-column grid. Left side (col-span-5): border-left 4px solid #D4AF37, padding-left 48px, text-size 60px (text-6xl). Right side (col-span-6, start-7): Right-aligned text for lead paragraph, followed by a 2-column grid for sub-points. Sub-points: border-top 1px solid #2C2C2C, italic numbers in 'Outfit' font using color #D4AF37.

### Solution Bento Grid
Background #1F3A5F (Navy), text #FFFFFF. Padding 96px vertical. 4-column grid with 1px white/20% opacity borders between items. Each card: Padding 48px (p-12). Icons: 36px size, color #D4AF37. Hover: Item background transitions to white/5% opacity.

### Services Grid
Background #F9F8F6, padding 96px vertical. Heading: text-6xl. Services: 3-column grid, items staggered vertically (mt-0, mt-12, mt-24). Each item: 1px horizontal #D4AF37 line that expands from 48px width to full width on hover. Heading: text-2xl. Body: leading-relaxed.

### Vertical Process Timeline
Background #FFFFFF. Central vertical line 1px solid #1F3A5F at 10% opacity. Timeline nodes: 32px square boxes (w-8 h-8) with alternating colors (#1F3A5F and #D4AF37). Layout: alternating content blocks. Step number: white text, size 12px. Step titles: 'Outfit' font, italicized, text-3xl.

### Reservation Form
Background #F9F8F6. 12-column grid. Inputs: No background, only 1px solid #2C2C2C bottom border. Placeholder: 'Outfit' font, italic, #2C2C2C at 30% opacity. Form elements spaced with 48px (space-y-12). Submit button: background #D4AF37, white text, uppercase, tracking 0.3em, full width on mobile, auto width on desktop.

### Footer
Background #FFFFFF, border-top 1px solid #2C2C2C (5% opacity). Single row flexbox (justify-between), uppercase text-xs, tracking-widest, color #2C2C2C at 40% opacity.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Expanding Divider Line — A decorative separator that expands on parent hover.
Create a div with height 1px, width 48px, background #D4AF37. Apply a transition property of 'width' with duration 700ms. On parent hover, the width should expand to 100%.

### Underline Form Input — Minimalist text input with bottom-only border.
Input element with: border-none, border-bottom 1px solid #2C2C2C, background transparent, rounded-none. Focus state: border-bottom color #D4AF37, outline none. Placeholder: font-family 'Outfit', font-style italic, opacity 30%.

### Decorative Background Grid — Subtle vertical lines creating an architectural layout.
Position absolute container over the whole page, z-index -1. Four divs: width 1px, height 100%, background-color rgba(44, 44, 44, 0.05). Position them at left: 10%, 33.33%, 66.66%, and 90%.

## Notas Especiais
MUST NOT use border-radius; all corners must be perfectly sharp (0px). MUST use 'Outfit' for all headings and accents, and 'Inter' for paragraphs. MUST maintain the vertical grid lines at 10%, 33%, 66%, and 90% for desktop layouts to preserve the architectural feel. MUST use #D4AF37 sparingly for highlights. MUST use wide letter-spacing (0.3em) for all uppercase UI labels.
